plan.title: [framework-gap] BLOCKER Add audited interactive human overrides for framework gate blockers

narratives.Description: [framework-gap] BLOCKER Add audited interactive human overrides for framework gate blockers
narratives.Overview:
## Bound remedy (#5542 Prefer-A 6150081436)

1. Mint only via operator-cli human-presence authz:grant; operator-session non-admitting.
2. Atomic one-use admission bound to attempt id with baseSha+headSha+treeHash + gate id + refuse code.
3. Closed waived/overridden enum arms; never map to pass.
4. First eligible gate = coverage-applicability / coverage_headroom refuse; closed refuse codes.
5. Named v1 consumers MUST honor the grant (pre-PR coverage_headroom + coverage:hotspots).
6. Prefer authz template gate-override modeled on spec-drift-override.
7. Keep-outs: #5541 separate; no fabricate green; no UAT silent suspend.
